Read a PDF pathology report

Source: R/parsers.R
mp_read_pdf_report.Rd

Extract structured information from a pathology PDF report using pdftools::pdf_text() and regex-based section parsing. Complete extracted pages and text are retained in metadata even when section heuristics match only part of the report. Database report summaries use that complete text. This does not perform OCR or validate extraction accuracy against the PDF.

Usage

mp_read_pdf_report(path, template = "generic")

Arguments

path

Character scalar. Path to the .pdf file.

template

Character scalar. Template name controlling which regex patterns are applied. Currently "generic" (default) is supported.

Value

A molpath_parsed object whose data slot is a tibble with columns section and content extracted from the report (Patient, Sample, Findings, Interpretation, Recommendations).

Examples

# Write a small text PDF to a temporary file and parse it.
pdf_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
grDevices::pdf(pdf_file)
graphics::plot.new()
graphics::text(0.02, c(0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6), adj = 0, labels = c(
  "Patient: P001", "Sample: S001",
  "Findings: KRAS G12D detected",
  "Interpretation: pathogenic variant"
))
grDevices::dev.off()
#> agg_record_1a21445f8a62 
#>                       2 
result <- mp_read_pdf_report(pdf_file)
#> ℹ Reading PDF report: file1a2150ec5772.pdf (template: generic)
#> ✔ Extracted 3 section(s) from PDF report
result$data
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>   section        content                           
#>   <chr>          <chr>                             
#> 1 sample_info    Sample: S001                      
#> 2 findings       Findings: KRAS G12D detected      
#> 3 interpretation Interpretation: pathogenic variant
unlink(pdf_file)
